description: This file defines an abstract class 'AxisRenderer' that serves as a base for rendering axes in chart components. It includes methods for initializing axis titles, tick labels, line formats, and gridlines, with specific default settings and formatting rules. The class manages rendering details such as font styles, colors, tick mark types, and gridline styles, allowing derived classes to implement specific axis rendering behaviors in a .NET charting library.

classes.name: AxisRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class providing common initialization routines for all axis rendering classes in the charting library, managing titles, tick labels, gridlines, and line formatting.

methods.name: InitAxisTitle
methods.description: Initializes the axis title information within the renderer, setting font, alignment, and color properties based on the provided parameters and defaults.

methods.name: InitTickLabels
methods.description: Configures tick label fonts, colors, and formatting, with fallback to default formats if not specified.

methods.name: InitAxisLineFormat
methods.description: Sets up line formats for the axis, major and minor tick marks, and gridlines based on axis properties and defaults.

methods.name: InitGridlines
methods.description: Initializes the line styles for minor and major gridlines, considering user configurations or default behaviors.

methods.name: GetDefaultTickLabelsFormat
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide default formatting strings for tick labels.
